observation: Related qualified Ghidra surveys export 1,741 resident/field, 1,677 resident/battle and 1,127 resident/menu C bodies. Every exported body hash matches original source; repeated resident exports are not unique functions. Shared partial types, A0 operand forwarding, normal-startup GP and menu switch boundaries are corrected. Authored C++ matches 81,527 existing original event transitions. Preserved Python models match all 4,385 position calls in six qualified captures, including 626 active commits, 1,252 layer queries and 626 history writes.
interpretation: Ghidra C now supports connected loader/state/event/update/return documentation and a reusable event library. The menu first-table entries are switch labels, not ten functions. Startup GP resolves misleading low-address globals; arbitrary restored contexts remain dynamic. Field return snapshots are distinct from ordinary memory-card persistence. Broad provisional coverage and source-reviewed actor scheduling do not establish full gameplay or complete subsystem execution.
author: Codex /root, independent original-source analysis, 2026-09-08

preconditions: Qualified original Disc 1/profile and historical Ghidra imports; frozen verified Python models and EVID-REF-015/016 captures.
Pinned Ghidra 12.1.2/lab313ru PSX loader; original-derived types and context. No other Xenogears implementation or source map.
Position observations retain original entry/first-read lineage and uninstrumented controls. No opaque callee result substitutes for computed effects.
commands: Apply the retained type/operand/startup/menu review scripts to working copies of the qualified projects; export with ExportSubsystemSurvey.java or ExportSliceSurvey.java. Original bytes and raw C stay private.
env PYTHONPATH=. python .local/analysis/phase1-subsystems-20260908/qualify-surveys.py (choose a fresh result version when reproducing)
env PYTHONPATH=. python .local/analysis/phase1-subsystems-20260908/prepare-event-replay.py (choose a fresh adapter output)
Compile replay-events.cpp with src/reconstruction/field_events.cpp, -std=c++20 -I include -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all; run it on original-events-v1.bin.
env PYTHONPATH=. python .local/analysis/phase1-subsystems-20260908/compare-position-public.py <control|a|b|c|d|e> (choose fresh report versions)
cmake --build --preset sanitize; ctest --preset sanitize -R field-event-reconstruction; python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_position.py
validation.expected: Original body and export hash equality; exact captured event/position state and qualified controls; explicit unsupported dependencies. Synthetic tests cover connected scheduling and arithmetic boundaries without inventing original execution.
validation.actual: All 4,545 C exports qualify, including repeated resident contexts; all 81,527 event transitions and 4,385 position calls compare. Five connected C++ groups pass under sanitizers; 20 position tests pass. No Phase 1 todo or slice proof closes.
validation.tolerance: Exact original integer/byte/hash equality within each captured scope. No native tick-rate, hardware, full-scheduler or unobserved branch claim.

limitations: Automatic function boundaries, inferred types and stored references outside the reviewed subset remain provisional; stored references may lag corrected register context.

Scheduler eligibility/context publication and connected batches have source and synthetic checks, not a new complete original-scheduler capture. Ten primary C++ handlers do not execute the whole field script.
Observed branch modes remain those of EVID-REF-015; other selector defaults and arithmetic boundaries are source-only.

Position captures include idle NPC paths but do not recover the excluded NPC motion body. Failed layer queries, terrain/volume rollback and linked-floor variants remain unobserved or unresolved. Layer-query own scratch stack is outside byte comparison; parent stack and return lineage qualify separately.
Battle/menu exports do not implement combat, menu rules, auxiliary overlays, card persistence, required media, timing or semantic readiness. The battle result path has unresolved register context.
Independent review, all 15 broad Phase 1 todos and all nine slice proof domains remain open.

provenance.authorship: C++ and Python source are independently authored; existing verified Python is reused. Raw Ghidra output and original payloads are excluded from distribution.
